plus €500 DIT service fee per semester for enrolled students
If you are interested in applying to our university, choose what you aim to study and apply directly to DIT via our own online application portal, Primuss.

notes: Tuition: the programme's own DAAD page states 500 EUR per semester for applicants from non-EU countries (this covers Morocco). The English fee page describes it as a 'DIT service fee' of €500 per semester for non-EU/EEA students. The DAAD page also mentions a separate one-time 60 EUR application fee for international students from non-EU/EEA countries.
